{{Quote|Major Veers, you'll be good enough to escort us back to the garrison?|Commander Grath|<ref name="Promotion" />}}
[[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Grath''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] commanding officer of a detachment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] dispatched to [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]]. When Irrv's attempts to subdue the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] native, the [[Culroon]], with an exchange of ceremonial weapons [[Insurrection on Culroon III|failed]], Grath rallied the stormtrooper force long enough for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] to arrive in an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. Veers, who had suggested to Irrv that a show of force to the Culroon was necessary, expected an apology from the general. Irrv began to indicate that a court martial for disobeying orders was more appropriate, until Grath [[Death/Legends|killed]] him and gave Veers a field promotion to [[Major/Legends|Major]].

==Biography==
Grath<ref name="Promotion" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|commander]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Assigned to [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]], a backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]], he was tasked with overseeing security for the Imperial researchers on the world, along with the personnel constructing a [[IM-455 modular garrison|new Imperial garrison]].<ref name="FF31">{{FactFile|31|VEE 1-2|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref> The [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] tasked [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] with subjugating the planet, and he convinced the local [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], [[Kloff]], to agree to a ceremony that would see the native [[Culroon]] and the Empire exchange ceremonial weapons as a sign of their acceptance of Imperial military rule. Irrv's plan was questioned by [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], who had studied the Culroon while serving alongside Grath on the planet before Irrv's arrival. Veers believed that a show of force was necessary to subjugate the Culroon, and was sure that Kloff would be planning an attack on the ceremony.<ref name="Promotion" />

Grath and a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of stormtroopers attended the ceremony, wielding dress weapons designed for show rather than combat. As the ceremony started, Kloff accepted a [[Naval sword]] from Irrv, which he then used to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the general's aide, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jeffers]]. Kloff then sprung his [[Insurrection on Culroon III|ambush]], assaulting the Imperial force with hidden warriors armed with energy weapons that outclassed the Imperials' ceremonial showpieces. Grath rallied his troops and protected the general, but the weight of the assault soon began reducing the stormtrooper's numbers. However, Lieutenant Veers&mdash;who had been confined to base due to his disagreement with Irrv's plan&mdash;arrived in his [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] and began counter-attacking and driving off the Culroon. Grath led the remnants of his force to the safety of the [[Walker/Legends|walker]], where Veers expected Irrv to apologize to him. Irrv rebuked Veers, threatening him with a [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]], until Grath executed the general with a shot to the back before requesting that [[Major/Legends|''Major'']] Veers escort them back to the base.<ref name="Promotion" />
